title: Chapter 52: Each Showing His Special Ability
content:
Chapter 52: Each Showing His Special Ability

Perhaps the last two large-scale faith blessings of the bugbear priest consumed too much faith energy, resulting in no faith energy available. Their escape this time was not as fast as the priest the puppy chased last time.

This is good news. Wu Qing's Zerg war horses and Tiger tribe's tiger mounts are very fast, and the monitor lizard mounts will never be able to outrun them.

Seeing the back of the bugbear priest, Meng became even more excited. He kept urging the giant tiger under him to speed up. He quickly surpassed Wu Qing and ran to the first place.

The terrain here is not suitable for war horses to run. On the contrary, the thick giant palms of cats such as tigers have little effect on running in such a place.

Fortunately, Wu Qing's horse was Zerg inside, so his speed was not slowed down too much.

The two groups of people chased and escaped. Before they could escape from the complex terrain, the distance between the two groups was relatively close.

Wu Qing was afraid that something might happen if he continued chasing like this. These guys who believed in gods would always do some terrible things.

He transformed the spear in his hand into a long bow according to his will. He touched the armor with his right hand and drew out a proliferated long arrow.

He nocked a bow and drew an arrow on his high-speed horse, and shot an arrow with a bang.

A high-quality longbow transformed from biological reproductive equipment shot a powerful arrow.

With a whoosh, the arrow was like lightning and shot at a knight in the fleeing cavalry team. The knight fell off the lizard mount in response.

As soon as an arrow was shot, Wu Qing seemed to have found the feeling he had before. He stood up straight on his horse and fired ten consecutive arrows in a graceful manner without taking a breath.

Ten bugbear knights fell off their mounts in various postures, and hit eleven shots in a row!

"Good! Good archery skills!"

"Oh ho!"

Meng couldn't help but cheer loudly, and the tiger cavalry behind cheered loudly.

"Tiger warriors! Let us also show off our unique skills!"

Not to be outdone, Meng took out a well-made throwing spear from behind, and the loud sound echoed throughout the audience.

All the tiger cavalry responded to Meng's order and picked up their spears.

"charge!"

"roar……!"

A fierce charge order was issued, all kinds of tiger roars came together, and all the tiger cavalry accelerated again!

They were running normally just now, but now they were in a real charge state. The fleeing team in front was getting closer and closer.

Wu Qing no longer restricted the shape of the Zerg war horse and allowed it to develop freely. Only then did he run on par with these tiger cavalry without falling behind and losing face.

"Let these lackeys of the evil god see how powerful we are!"

"projection!"

With a fierce command, the tiger knights all stood up straight on the back of the high-speed running tiger, raised their spears and threw them in a uniform manner.

The powerful projection power of the Tiger Knight, coupled with the high speed of the Tiger's running, allowed the throwing spear to fly towards the fleeing bugbear cavalry team at an extremely high speed.

It was as if a forest of spears fell from the sky, densely covering the entire team.

A spear-throwing jungle instantly appeared on the ground. The hard and sharp spears were deeply inserted into the soil, blocking the direction of the bugbear cavalry.

There were also spears that pierced the bodies of bugbear knights and monitor lizard mounts. Those who were stabbed in the vital parts turned into light and disappeared.

The bugbear cavalry team is in chaos!

This wave of spear-throwing attacks by the tiger cavalry directly cut off the bugbear priest's way of survival.

The bugbear priest had fearless knights to defend him. He was not harmed for the time being, but his particularly huge lizard mount had several throwing spears inserted into it.

The Tiger Cavalry's special throwing spear can cause a lot of damage. The huge lizard, which is particularly tenacious, has several large blood holes in its body, and blood gushes out like spring water.

It can no longer run.

"Haha! Good job! Another vote!"

The Meng and Tiger cavalry took another throwing spear, and at a closer distance, threw a wave of spears at the bugbear cavalry who had been overwhelmed by the throwing spears.

Facing the powerful and intensive spear throwing once again, the escort cavalry of the bugbear priests were either killed or injured. Now there are less than twenty people who are still capable of fighting.

"Be careful of the sacrifice!"

Wu Qing had to remind him loudly.

He has encountered priests who launched powerful spiritual attacks before death. The Zerg are not afraid, but these Tiger cavalry should be more careful.

"Don't worry! I'm keeping an eye on him! He wants to do something small and wants to ask me if I will answer!"

Meng seemed to know the various abilities of the priest and responded with confidence.

Now that Mengdu understands, Wu Qing doesn't have to worry about them.

He was not idle either, picking up his bow and arrow and continuing to shoot at the remaining knights who had surrounded the bugbear priests tightly.

One arrow at a time, no missed shot.

Meng Ye threw a few more precise spears, clearing the bugbear knights.

Wu Qing took a look and saw that the bugbear priest was indeed praying with his eyes closed again.

"Wake up!"

Seeing this, his tiger eyes widened and he let out a loud roar, which sounded like rolling thunder. Wu Qing felt like it was deafening.

This should be a special sonic attack technique. The bugbear priest who withstood the full power of this attack had his prayers interrupted. His eyes opened and his seven orifices were bleeding.

"Haha! You have today too!"

"Wu Qing! Shoot him!"

Yelled excitedly.

Now that there was no interference, Wu Qing shot an arrow directly into the chest of the bugbear priest.

The bugbear priest was also a bugbear. He was tall and strong, and this fatal arrow did not kill him immediately.

But the bear goblin priest, who was under double attack, was no longer able to do anything else.

Wu Qing chose to trust Meng's professionalism. He saw a large group of tiger cavalrymen surrounding him and did not warn him again.

"Haha, priest! I didn't expect you to have this day, did you?"

Meng waved the big knife in his hand, swept down the spears standing in the forest, and slowly walked to the bear goblin priest who was sitting on the back of the giant lizard.

"I have to tell you a bad news. After killing you, you will also be sacrificed!"

"In this way, you can't go back to the gods you believe in!"

"Hahaha...!"

Meng's words completely touched the nerves of the bear goblin priest. The priest who had been acting very indifferent suddenly struggled.

The face of the bear goblin priest also became hideous and terrifying.

"What's the use of struggling! I'll send you on your way!"

Meng's big knife was as fast as lightning. With a click, he chopped off the head of the bear goblin priest.

Before the bloody scene was shown, the bear goblin priest disappeared in light.

This function of the system is very harmonious!

Seeing Wu Qing not saying anything, Meng explained: "These priests are the most cruel in the evil god camp. They can do anything for the evil god!"

"I stimulate him like this. His emotional fluctuations can bring us greater gains!"

After killing the bear goblin priest, Meng's emotions were released and he became much calmer.

"Can it be operated like this?"

"Of course, the evil god can use emotional energy, and correspondingly, the invisible luck can also be used."

Meng simply explained to Wu Qing.

"Let's go! Go back and clean up all the enemies first!"

"I haven't moved my body yet!"

Seeing the puppies roaming nearby, Meng no longer cared about the scene here and shouted Wu Qing to return to the battlefield. He wanted to fight again.
